mapper.sql: cot.id AS id, cot.crm_opportunity_activity_id AS activityId, coa.name AS activityName, cot.name AS taskName, cot.created AS created, CONCAT(creator.first_name, ' ', creator.last_name) AS createdBy, cot.modified AS modified, CONCAT(modifier.first_name, ' ', modifier.last_name) AS modifiedBy

FROM crm_opportunity_tasks AS cot INNER JOIN crm_opportunity_activities AS coa ON coa.id = cot.crm_opportunity_activity_id LEFT JOIN users AS creator ON creator.id = cot.created_by LEFT JOIN users AS modifier ON modifier.id = cot.modified_by

WHERE cot.is_active = 1 AND coa.is_active = 1
AND ( cot.name LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%") OR coa.name LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%") )
mapper.select:
SELECT
WHERE cot.is_active = 1 AND coa.is_active = 1 AND cot.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_opportunity_tasks(crm_opportunity_activity_id, name, created, created_by, is_active) VALUES (#{task.activityId}, #{task.name}, NOW(), #{task.createdBy}, #{task.isActive})
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_opportunity_tasks SET crm_opportunity_activity_id = #{task.activityId}, name = #{task.name}, modified = NOW(), modified_by = #{task.modifiedBy} WHERE id = #{task.id} AND is_active = 1
